name: Interactive Gaussian splat embedding for a Hugo static site

mentions.name: Interactive Gaussian splat embedding for a Hugo static site
mentions.description: This project captures and embeds interactive Gaussian splats into pages on a simple Hugo-based static website.
mentions.problem: No good embeddable option has been found that doesn't assume a huge dynamic website instead of a simple Hugo-based static site.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on some pages for my websites and want to capture + embed some interactive gaussian splats. I haven't yet found a good, embedded-able option that doesn't assume a huge dynamic website instead of my simple Hugo based static site.
